title: Development of a Machine Learning-Based Autophagy-Related lncRNA Signature to Improve Prognosis Prediction in Osteosarcoma Patients.
summary: Kaplan-Meier/ROC analyses and the independent GSE39055 cohort assessed survival stratification; the source reports an independent prognostic association. This remains retrospective bioinformatic evidence and does not establish treatment response or prospective clinical value.
ai_technology: Repeated lasso-Cox selection and multivariable Cox modeling formed a 13-lncRNA autophagy-related prognostic score for osteosarcoma.
